svg.text: Marlow Yard re-plan (job J14): one forced route, every co-op move taught once, then splits
To scale, 1 m = 7 px, north up (+z). Drawn from the set coordinates in src/world/maps/ctcourseSets/*.ts (master 2148ec96). Ground floor; upper decks dotted-hatched.
Badges 1-13: what each set teaches, in order. Thick line: the one forced route. Dashed line: the partner's part of a co-op step or the second leg of a split.
checker: blind, kept for grab practice
beam panel out of jam reach
public stair, loop round the counters, ghost or take both
Second leg of a split (A7, A8)
Partner's side trip (an isolator, the crawl)
Seated role-player who cannot see or hear (A1)
Timed drill and its limit (a miss retries in place)
Lamp in a cage: cannot be shot (A2 neck)
Lamp added or re-lamped (no dead lamps)
Upper deck (gallery, bridge, office at 4.4 m)
What the set teaches, in order

Teaching order: 1 boost up a wall, 2 human ladder (climb your partner), 3 hold a shutter, 4 timed light isolation, 5 vent unlock, 6 jam relay, 7 security-room camera loop, 8 synced takedown, 9 throw over a gap,

10 rope, 11 hang-down, then 12 split paths with a synced hack and 13 the graduation. Every co-op kit move (G293) is taught once, on its own, before the A7 split; A8 is the only area that keeps side routes (Q24).
Every lamp works (Q2): darkness comes only from cover, cut circuits and shot lamps. A failed drill retries that drill in place; nothing in Marlow Yard fails the set or sends you back (Q5).

Guard, camera, lamp, drill and closure positions are taken from the built sets or are the planned change; the stores-bay wall (A2), the crawl (A3) and the pallet closures (A4) are new and placed to the 0.5 m grid at build.
